short_description: This borehole data includes temperature and pressure records. This dataset is open for public access under the CC BY-NC-SA license.
documentation:
This borehole data includes temperature and pressure records from three sites in Svalbard. These sites started operation on July 11th, 2021, and ended on May 4th, 2023. 

For methodology and additional information, including instrument specifications and measurement uncertainties/limitations, please see the relevant publication available at https://www.mdpi.com/2073-4441/18/6/661.
